definitions.ask: Where should the review bucket read `GTD` instead of `GTD review`?
definitions.why: The dash has room, and there `review` separates the bucket from the gtd area row

choices.label: Day strip legend only, via a new `short_label`; dash, chips, and CLI keep `GTD review`
Every surface (strip, dash, chips, CLI, plan JSON) says `GTD`; more fixtures and docs change

definitions.ask: When the legend cannot name every root with its minutes, should it drop the minutes so it can name more roots?
definitions.why: The goal is a name for every colour; minutes stay one hover away

choices.label: Legend drops minutes (kept in tooltips) whenever that names more roots
Every item keeps its minutes; roots that don't fit go into `+N`

definitions.ask: If the bucket is renamed everywhere, update the root-parent glossary strand's `GTD review`?
